title: Register layout for a scan
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $R$ be a register record, and let $n,s,pos$ be natural numbers. The scan layout is the register record obtained from $R$ by setting registers $N1$ and $Wp$ to $n+1$ and $w_P(n)$, respectively; setting $E$ and $Q1$ to $2n+2+4W(N)s+2W(N)$, $F$ to that quantity plus $2w_P(n)$, and $U$ to that quantity plus $2w_P(n)+4$; and setting $Pos$ to $pos$. Every other register retains its value from $R$.
